top_repositories.why_developers_should_care: Security engineers and developers building autonomous agents can leverage its 130-tool catalog and escalation chains to integrate robust vulnerability scanning and penetration-testing workflows natively.
top_repositories.momentum: Solid early adoption and strong thematic relevance given the explosion of MCP-based servers.
top_repositories.novelty: High novelty in combining universal Model Context Protocol capabilities with a dedicated red/blue-team penetration-testing toolbelt.
